metadata.description: grain — ask a repository about its own conventions before writing code.

plugins.name: grain
plugins.description: Ask a repository about its own conventions before writing code: where <intent> (where such things live, what is expected there, exemplars to copy), check <file> (how a file sits against the local norm), spectrum <file>, status/report, export (the whole model as JSON for training pipelines), seed (a committed maintainer decision that steers a pattern). Statistical answers mined from the repo's syntax trees and full git history; no model calls, no network, never blocks.
